Common.questionsPrefix: If you have any questions, write to us at

OrderPlaced.subject: Order #{id} placed
OrderPlaced.watchStatus: You can track your order status in your account.
OrderPlaced.textFallback:
Order #{id} has been placed.

We are preparing your order and will dispatch it shortly.

OrderCompleted.preview: Order #{id} completed - thank you for your purchase!
OrderCompleted.subject: Order #{id} completed
OrderCompleted.bodyOrder: Order #{id} has been completed. Thank you for choosing us!
OrderCompleted.bodyPromo: We’d love to see you again. Check out new arrivals in our store.
OrderCompleted.textFallback: Order #{id} completed. Thank you for your purchase!

Fulfillment.subject: Order #{id} is being prepared
Fulfillment.bodyOrder: Order #{id} has been packed and is waiting to be handed to the carrier.
Fulfillment.nextStep: We will send you the tracking number as soon as the parcel is on its way.

Shipment.subject: Order #{id} shipped
Shipment.headingWithName: {name}, your order is on its way!
Shipment.headingAnon: Your order is on its way!
Shipment.bodyOrder: Order #{id} has been handed to the delivery service.
Shipment.noTracking: The tracking number will be added to your order in your account once the parcel is handed to the carrier.
Shipment.deliveryTime: Standard delivery takes 1-7 business days depending on your region.

Delivery.subject: Order #{id} delivered
Delivery.bodyOrder: Order #{id} has been delivered. We hope everything arrived in good shape.
Delivery.somethingWrong: If anything is wrong with the order, tell us within 14 days and we will sort it out.

OrderCanceled.subject: Order #{id} canceled
OrderCanceled.refundNote: If the order was paid for, the money goes back to the card it was paid with. Banks usually need up to 10 business days to show it.

Payment.subject: Order #{id} paid
Payment.bodyOrder: Order #{id} has been successfully paid. We are now preparing it for dispatch.
Payment.watchStatus: You can track your order status in your account.
Payment.textFallback:
Order #{id} has been paid.

We are preparing your order and will dispatch it shortly.

PasswordReset.preview: Password reset - link valid for 15 minutes
PasswordReset.subject: Password reset
PasswordReset.heading: Password reset
PasswordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for {email}. Click the button below to set a new password.
PasswordReset.hint: The link is valid for 15 minutes. If you didn’t request a password reset, simply ignore this email.
PasswordReset.textFallback:
Password reset

To reset your password, follow the link (valid for 15 minutes):
{url}

If you didn’t request a password reset, simply ignore this email.

OrderTransfer.subject: Order #{id} transfer request
OrderTransfer.heading: Order transfer request
OrderTransfer.body: A request was made to transfer order #{id} to another account. If this was you, confirm the transfer using the button below. If not, simply ignore this email.
OrderTransfer.hint: The order will only be transferred after your confirmation. If you didn’t request a transfer, nothing will happen to your order.
OrderTransfer.textFallback:
Order #{id} transfer request

To review the request, follow the link:
{url}

If you didn’t request a transfer, simply ignore this email.

Welcome.subject: Welcome!
Welcome.body: Thanks for signing up! Your account is ready - now you can check out faster, track your orders, and save delivery addresses in your account.
